what_to_detect: A resolution after which a player holds a new permanent designation (an enduring story), shown by a state_flag_change event or a designation on the player in the snapshot after the resolution.
near_miss: A resolution of the same ability after which the player holds no such designation.
record_fields: state_flag_change event flag/value, if the collector emits the designation (Forge sets it through Player.setEnduringStory, which puts an 'An Enduring Story' effect card in the command zone)
a zone_change of that effect card to the command zone
a player designation in the snapshot (not among the gen-3 player fields speed, city_blessing, rad, monarch, initiative)

what_to_detect: A player keeps a designation (an enduring story) in later snapshots after the permanents that gave it left the battlefield.
near_miss: The designation absent after the same ability resolved.
record_fields: state_flag_change event flag/value, if the collector emits the designation (Forge sets it through Player.setEnduringStory, which puts an 'An Enduring Story' effect card in the command zone)
a zone_change of that effect card to the command zone
a player designation in the snapshot (not among the gen-3 player fields speed, city_blessing, rad, monarch, initiative)
